files.design: Only the main preview reference uses the existing large two-row rewrite-01-character-ids.svg. Old character_ids.svg stays available for other references. Both figures use 貓看狗，狗看貓。 and IDs 3/2/1/4/1/2/3/0.

Each group has an adjacent 答案：圓 or 答案：方 label at the left and a 前文 heading centered over the character region. Original tokens, gray/input distinctions, 1/3/5-character window rectangles and red→circle/blue→square rule remain identical.

Two vertically stacked large-text cards, 640×1370 viewbox; numeric values move above the bars. All labels use at least 30px. The four bar widths use one common 120 viewbox px per displayed numerical unit (increased visual length from the original approximately 80px/unit; identical numeric comparison, zero origin, no new data). EOS target counts, common denominator 4,193 UTF-8 bytes, conversion to bit, lower-is-better rule and inference limit stay visible.

Two vertically stacked large-text cards, 640×1345 viewbox. ECE and Brier occupy separate lines. All labels use at least 30px. Original 560px 0–100% bar scales, confidence widths 492.576/519.288 and fixed accuracy marker x=472 remain identical; validation selection and separate test denominator remain above the cards. All numerical results and low/high inference boundary stay visible.

Narrow 640×1900 vertical flow with three groups. Preparation, prediction versus scoring, and update steps are stacked. Body labels use 32px, API and scope notes 30px. X plus readable-history mask remains separate from Y plus scoring positions. One zero_grad → backward → optimizer.step sequence and the deliberate-accumulation exception remain explicit; no new learning concept added.
